name: Blok
description: The warden: a knight of the brood in bronze plate from the crown down. A rounded great helm with a crest ridge and two husk mandibles for cheek-guards, the face set hard in the opening; pauldrons on both shoulders shaped from a beetle's elytra and big enough to sleep under; a riveted cuirass a size wider than any other survivor's, plated arms and legs a quarter thicker. On the far arm a shield cut from a Soldier's back-plate, and at the belt the spore pods this one lays behind it as it walks: cold-fused, because a warm glow in this world is a thing calling to the hive. The dead feelers stand short and thick from the helm. Same dead organ as the rest, set in the breastplate. The block it used to be is the shape it still cuts. Drawn facing +x; the game flips it.

idle.description: the slowest breath on the roster — the whole bronze mass settles and rises as one, the pauldrons a beat late, the shield resting, the two fuses ticking cold on the pods

walk.description: a stomp: short strides on plated legs, the whole mass dropping onto each foot, the shield riding the far arm, the pods swinging at the belt
